lines.speaker: Professor McGonagall
lines.text: Open this door right now, Potter. I will not have students vanish from a school event while the caretaker chases shadows.
lines.expression: square jaw, wand leveled at the seam of the hidden door, eyes narrowed against the dim torchlight

lines.speaker: Harry Potter
lines.text: I slipped away for air, Professor. No one else is here and the cloak never left my trunk.
lines.expression: shoulders deliberately relaxed, hands open at his sides, gaze steady on her face
